run_test_suite: run the full unittest test suite discovered from the tests directory matching test_*.py pattern
run_specific_test: run a specific unittest by name such as test_gaussians_pcl.TestGaussiansPCL.test_visualize_pcl_reprojection
discover_tests: discover all test modules in a directory using unittest.TestLoader with a glob pattern
load_test_by_name: load a specific test case from a module by fully qualified test name string
run_test_runner: execute a unittest test suite with verbosity level 2 using TextTestRunner
